title: Karma
lead_summary: Karma is a hidden value in the game that is used to encounter specific Legendary Pokémon.
missable_warnings: NOTE: Contains actions that alter player Karma.

Karma is a hidden value in the game that is used to encounter specific [[Legendary Pokémon]]. == Checking Your Karma Level == In [[Ecruteak City]], in the house to the far north-east, there is an old lady whose dialogue as well as the floor of the room will indicate the player's current karma level. {| class="IFTable sortable" ! data-sort-type="number" | Karma ! Dialogue |- | data-sort-value="-21" | Below -20 | You seem like a very mean person. You have a lot of anger in your heart. |- | data-sort-value="-20" | -20 to -11 | You don't strike me as a particularly good person... |- | data-sort-value="-10" | -10 to -1 | You strike me as someone who can be a bit mean-spirited sometimes, but still generally well-intentionned. |- | data-sort-value="0" | 0 | You strike me as  a very neutral person. Neither good, nor bad. |- | data-sort-value="10" | 1 to 10 | You strike me as someone who generally tries to do the right thing, but your heart isn't completely pure either. |- | data-sort-value="30" | 11 to 30 | You strike me as someone who generally tries to do the right thing, but you could also do a bit more. |- | data-sort-value="50" | 31 to 50 | You strike me as someone who tries its earnest to always do the right thing. |- | data-sort-value="51" | 51 or more | You seem like you're very pure of heart and always willing to help the ones in need. |- ! colspan="2" height="10" | |} KarmaHouse_lt_-20.png|Below -20|alt=The Karma House when the player's Karma is below -20 KarmaHouse_lt_-10.png|-20 to -11|alt=The Karma House when the player's Karma is between -20 and -11 KarmaHouse_lt_0.png|-10 to -1|alt=The Karma House when the player's Karma is between -10 and -1 KarmaHouse_0.png|0 |alt=The Karma House when the player's Karma is 0 KarmaHouse_gt_0.png|1 to 30|alt=The Karma House when the player's Karma is between 1 and 30 KarmaHouse_gt_30.png|31 to 50|alt=The Karma House when the player's Karma is between 31 and 50 KarmaHouse_gt_50.png|51 or more|alt=The Karma House when the player's Karma is 51 or more == Changing Your Karma Level == There are a variety of actions that can raise or lower the player's karma. === Raise === {| class="IFTable sortable" !
